Theorem
[Linear trace Harnack estimate] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0395, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0396 1. appD:D.28\group Harnack Estimates

Let $\partial _tg=-2\operatorname {Ric}$ and $\partial _th=\Delta _Lh$, where $g(t)$ is complete with bounded nonnegative curvature operator, $h(0)\geq 0$, and $h$ obeys the exponential initial growth and Gaussian space-time integrability hypotheses in the source. Then $h(t)\geq 0$, and for every vector field $V$, \[ \operatorname {div}(\operatorname {div}h)+\langle \operatorname {Ric},h\rangle +2\langle \operatorname {div}h,V\rangle +h(V,V)+\frac{\operatorname {tr}h}{2t} \geq 0. \]
